title: "built this entirely through AI collaboration from an entrepreneur's perspective, not a developer's"
author: LaonBuilds
selftext: not a developer, i'm coming at this purely as an entrepreneur who built a pixel tycoon game almost entirely through AI (claude + chatgpt) over the past few months, just finished putting together an actual trailer for it since i only had screenshots to show before. it's a business sim about running a skincare startup, funding choices, quality vs speed tradeoffs, whether to cover up a bad batch or eat the loss, stuff like that. still completely free on itch, no payment option at all. genuinely curious what this community thinks of both the trailer itself and the "can ai actually finish a game" question since that was basically the whole point of doing this
